announcements.title: Uolon Horn needs tokens
announcements.body: Uolon Horn costs 100 tomes + 10 Uolon Horn Tokens. Minimog gives 1/week, Ultimog (Aloalo Island x6) gives 5. You need Ultimog + 5 of 6 minimogs, or wait for Second Hunt — tokens carry over.

announcements.title: Weekly objective
announcements.body: One random standard duty is assigned weekly for +20 tomes (claim in Mogpendium). Hidden Gorge matches are frequent during this event.

announcements.title: Claim and exchange deadlines
announcements.body: Tomes can only be earned during the event (ends Oct 19). Mogpendium reward claims stay open until Patch 8.05; the Itinerant Moogle item exchange stays open until Patch 8.1.

announcements.title: Also live right now
announcements.body: Overlapping this event: FFXV collab 'A Nocturne for Heroes' (until Oct 13, Regalia mount), Fall Guys collab in the Gold Saucer (Oct 7–27, MGF prizes), and Ranked CC Season 21 (until Patch 7.58). Note: Crucible Rankings Season One is postponed (no new date yet); Patch 7.57 lands Oct 28 with the 'Keybound Brawler' beastmaster quest.
